Write proposed changes to a temporary file and replace storage
atomically. Publish the in-memory change only after saving succeeds,
and reject external file edits instead of silently overwriting them.
Show storage failures in both command interfaces and GUI card actions.

Add isolated tests for permissions, malformed records, invalid UTF-8,
external changes, restart round trips, and preservation of original
bytes. Document recovery steps and extend the console test plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor workflows to follow SLAP
commitResults.messageBody:
Several methods mix high-level workflows with parsing, formatting,
file operations, and GUI event handling. This makes their intent harder
to follow and obscures important persistence and interaction rules.

Extract named helpers to apply the Single Level of Abstraction
Principle (SLAP):
- Separate console startup, input processing, and command dispatch.
- Move console warnings and error formatting into Ui.
- Separate task reconstruction from validation and persistence.
- Reuse task reconstruction and replacement when changing status.
- Separate storage checks, serialization, atomic writes, and recovery.
- Separate sidebar and task-card construction from action handlers.
- Parse task-card display fields into a private record.

Preserve command output, task metadata, save-before-publish behavior,
stale-card protection, navigation state, and completion delays. Keep
the existing UI test plan unchanged because its expectations remain
accurate.

Verify with Java 25:
- Pass all 67 JUnit tests and both Checkstyle checks.
- Pass all 15 console sessions with exact output comparisons.
- Pass 16 focused JavaFX checks for navigation and task-card behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task update rules and storage record encoding
commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList mixes collection management with per-type replacement rules,
while Storage mixes safe file operations with the task record format.

Move validated replacement creation into TaskUpdater and record
encoding, UTF-8 decoding, and parsing into TaskCodec. Keep copies
isolated until a save succeeds and retain existing validation errors,
record formats, damaged-file recovery, and external-edit protection.

plan's expected inputs and outputs remain accurate.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move task confirmations and errors into the CLI

GUI, coupling shared task operations to one presentation layer.

Move successful add/update confirmations and numbered-command error
formatting into Stewie. Let invalid model indices raise documented
exceptions, and keep GUI validation in its command and card handlers.
Use formatted snapshots for CLI confirmations without exposing mutable
tasks, retaining the existing Ui overloads for task objects.

Preserve all CLI messages and ensure GUI operations no longer print
CLI confirmations. Add a silent-model regression test and update the
UI plan with the terminal-output check for GUI task operations.

Validate with 74 Java 25 unit tests, Checkstyle, all 15 ordered console
cases, and native JavaFX navigation, card, timer, and save-error checks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Javadoc headers with SE-EDU conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
Existing headers mix imperative summaries, incomplete tag descriptions,
and compact class and method comments. Some also misdescribe task dates,
completion markers, and update-field checks.

Standardize block formatting, third-person summaries, tag punctuation,
and header spacing across production and test sources. Clarify model
validation and formatted output so callers can understand the contracts
without reading the implementation. Preserve all executable code.

Keep the UI plan unchanged because console behavior is unaffected.
Verify with Java 25: all 15 console cases and 74 automated tests pass,
as do Checkstyle checks. Generate Javadoc successfully; remaining
warnings cover enum constants, implicit constructors, and optional tags.
